2\. The budget grace period can start early 🐞 Bug ≡ Correctness 
Exchange._handle() records first_refusal_ms before its synchronous state-file save and before
constructing the budget-refusal response. If that save or the request thread is delayed, the toolkit
counts the delay against the 30-second grace period and can kill the harness before it receives the
refusal.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description The state timestamp is captured before the state write and refusal response are constructed, allowing gateway-side delay to consume the harness's grace period. ## Fix Focus Areas - hb/gateway.py[553-556] - hb/gateway.py[712-716] - hb/gateway.py[1019-1025] ## Recommended Fix Record the refusal time at the point used for the budget-refusal record, without placing a potentially slow state-file write between the timestamp and that decision.
